description: Resize any image to exact social media dimensions — Instagram post, story, Facebook cover, X header, YouTube thumbnail, LinkedIn and more — with cover or fit modes.

faqs.a: Instagram Post (1080×1080), Instagram Story/Reel (1080×1920), Facebook Post (1200×630), Facebook Cover (820×312), X Header (1500×500), X Post (1200×675), YouTube Thumbnail (1280×720), LinkedIn Post (1200×627) and Pinterest Pin (1000×1500).
“Cover” fills the whole frame and crops the overflow (best for backgrounds). “Fit” shows the entire image with blurred padding filling the rest.
faqs.q: What is the difference between Cover and Fit?

faqs.a: Yes — a custom width and height option lets you set any size.
faqs.q: Can I set a custom size?

faqs.a: No — resizing happens entirely in your browser.

howto: Pick a social platform preset (or enter a custom size).
Choose Cover (crop to fill) or Fit (whole image, blurred padding).
title: Social Image Sizer
